name: Global Acyclicity Disguise
description: Transforms a local pairwise inequality constraint (graph coloring) into a global directed acyclicity constraint by defining edge directions based on divisibility. Equal values create 2-cycles, while unequal values strictly orient edges from 1 to {2,3} or create no edges at all, making cycles impossible. This prevents models from recognizing the problem as graph coloring and applying DSATUR or max-degree heuristics, forcing them to use naive backtracking with cycle detection which will TLE on hard instances.
